facts.claim: The Wallace Flour Mill was initially established in 1888 as a joint stock company.
facts.quote: The Wallace Four Mill, originally started in 1888 as a joint stock com- pany, was purchased soon after by a wealthy Bhattia and is not a purely private concern.

facts.claim: The registered trademark of the mill products is the Anchor, which is well-known throughout India and East Africa.

facts.claim: The Piru Mahomed Mill was established in 1887 and is located in Byculla.
facts.quote: It was established in 1887 and is situated in Byculla. It is a joint stock concern with a capital of 3 lakhs.
